coder_notes: Trimipramine and atezolizumab are the investigational agents; bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy given to all patients as part of the combination (dose 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks in both cohorts), coded soc_backbone rather than established_therapy_experiment because the record does not frame its own dose or schedule as the question. Atezolizumab and bevacizumab are registered as separate cohort-specific interventions (Cohort 1/Cohort 2); merged here into one row per moiety. Cohort 2 is a tumour/CSF trimipramine concentration cohort.
